metadata.description: Layerable baseline skills for Claude Code — general guidance that consumer repos can extend with project-specific overlays.

plugins.name: skill-layers
plugins.description: Baseline skills that auto-load a project-local overlay if one exists. Each baseline (e.g. code-review) is fully usable as shipped; when a consumer repo provides .claude/skills/<baseline>-overlay/SKILL.md, the baseline reads it and treats its rules as additional, equally-binding constraints. Overlays are also invocable standalone for quick project-conventions checks.
